business.name: Skill Swap
business.summary: A private team workspace for reusable AI skills and plugins. Individual contributions become shared capability through a clear library, independent review and approved releases. The promise is: Your team's know-how, ready to use. The visual identity is warm and editorial. The dimensional logo MUST be built from layered heavyweight paper or card, with broad geometric pieces, controlled folds, substantial thickness, visible edges and restrained fiber texture. Explore three distinct territories: joined modules, a folded shared object, and parts framing an open shared space.
business.audience: Teammates with mixed technical confidence, including newcomers discovering and using AI skills; Builders and trusted approvers maintain the shared library.

concept.metaphor_text: Independently contributed parts make an accessible shared team library
concept.description: Two broad green card leaves have rounded outward returns along their outer long edges. A terracotta folded lower shelf reaches both leaves at separate seams. Thick pale cut cores are visible between colored front and back skins. The large central opening stays open across the full top; there is no backing plate or enclosing border.

plan.hypothesis: An open shared team library formed by independently contributed parts
plan.visual_mechanism: Two broad green card leaves have rounded outward returns along their outer long edges. A terracotta folded lower shelf reaches both leaves at separate seams. Thick pale cut cores are visible between colored front and back skins. The large central opening stays open across the full top; there is no backing plate or enclosing border. This is the open-space territory. Joined-index and the retained shared-folio preserve the other two territories. Supplied dark green, pale green and terracotta palette roles distinguish the three paper parts. Manrope 700 and DM Sans 400 remain for adjacent naming and UI; no fine lettering appears inside the mark. The broad three-part core is shared by the flat master for app icons, favicons and monochrome use; laminate edges and rounded scores are hero detail.
assumptions: These are authored alternatives for visual evaluation; owner artistic acceptance remains unknown

details.purpose: Make substantial paper edges and layered construction visible rather than plastic slabs
details.intended_scale: Hero and native detail; the flat silhouette remains broad
details.construction: Each card has a constant 0.068-unit stock thickness measured normal to its local surface: 0.052 pale core between 0.008 colored skins. Rounded centerline scores carry all layers through the fold at their respective offset radii. The lower shelf is trimmed against the upper leaves to form two separate butt-contact seams, without a claimed fastener or closed frame. All nine supported mesh assets are closed, consistently wound and use matte paper fiber materials.
details.deletion_test: Removing the pale core hides the stock construction; removing constant normal thickness creates visibly inconsistent edges around the folds.

details.feature: Rounded outward scores and open shared shelf
details.purpose: Give each paper part a visible change of plane and a specific role around an accessible common space
details.intended_scale: Hero folds; three broad contributions survive in the flat mark
details.construction: The two upper leaves each bend outward once around a 0.05-unit centerline score radius. The lower terracotta sheet bends upward at a 0.04-unit score and reaches both leaves in separate butt seams. Mesh intersections are removed; no fastener, freestanding load capacity, backing plane, top bridge or enclosing border is claimed.
details.deletion_test: Without the score returns the leaves read as flat cutouts. Without the shared low shelf the two leaves become unrelated panels. A continuous top or backing would violate the open-structure direction.
